facts.fact: iAfrica reports that the government meeting chaired by the Prime Minister on 25 May 2026 reviewed Algeria's six-pillar National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, which is in active implementation, was first developed in 2019 and was revised in 2024.
iAfrica reports that a dedicated AI Council was established to advise the government and guide cross-sectoral policy on AI, alongside the 2024 revision of the strategy.
